title: Micro decision tally and coverage fingerprint (ad-hoc)
content:
Sheet: Micro decision tally & coverage fingerprint (purpose: quick one-page cross-team intake for small pending decisions)

COLUMNS: id | decision_summary | impact_area | provisional_owner | decision_date | status | follow_up_action | due | quick_notes

Rows:
1 | Route-fallback priority: use smaller quantized v1 as soft-fallback vs region routing | serving-runtime / routing | Marco Chen | 2027-06-10 | need_input | confirm perf delta on p99 tail at 512 tokens; update fallback policy doc | 2027-06-18 | rough perf numbers: 7% cost saving, +18ms tail; ops wary of hallucination delta
2 | Quant pilot: enable 4-bit profile on dedicated pools for low-latency text embeddings | applied-ml / dedicated | Sofia Ramos | 2027-06-11 | in_progress | run 48h A/B on embedding similarity score drift; tag test traffic | 2027-06-20 | small drift on long-doc recall; ML to scope eval suite
3 | Telemetry tag alignment between billing and console traces (unified route id) | observability / billing | Elias Novak | 2027-06-09 | blocked | get schema approval from finance; update ingestion lambda | 2027-06-22 | finance requests sample cost impact before approval
4 | SLO rollback plan for canary that pushed higher latency at peak | site-reliability-engineering | Priya Singh | 2027-06-12 | in_progress | schedule canary pause + mitigate via autoscale tweak | 2027-06-14 | manual pause executed; monitoring OK but need decision on permanent fix
5 | Quick rightsizing ask: reserve 2x burst capacity for SE pilot next week | product-dedicated | Omar Ruiz | 2027-06-13 | proposed | confirm billing owner and approval window | 2027-06-15 | pilot scoped for demo; cost estimate ~$1.6k/day
6 | Minimal prompt set regression check for model swap (gpt-like -> open-moderate) | developer-experience / hosted-api | Asha Patel | 2027-06-11 | need_input | compile 30 customer prompts, run side-by-side, summarize false-positive rate | 2027-06-19 | ask SEs for customer sample prompts; privacy scrub required
7 | Regional capacity pledge contact: add APAC partner rep to on-call cascade | private-deployments / partnerships | Mei Tan | 2027-06-11 | done | confirm contact update in runbook | 2027-06-12 | contact added; still need SLA doc update
8 | Billing reconciliation for one-off credits issued during migration window | finance-and-legal | Ravi Desai | 2027-06-08 | in_review | finalize credits list and export to billing system | 2027-06-16 | discrepancies: ~12 customer rows need manual review
9 | Lightweight A/B: enable prefix-KV cache for low-latency chat route for 5% sample | serving-runtime | Marco Chen | 2027-06-14 | proposed | measure latency delta and token cost over 24h | 2027-06-21 | aim: keep p95 <= 80ms and cut token cost 10%
10 | Quick policy question: should we flag experimental routes in console UI? | console-and-tooling | Lina Morales | 2027-06-10 | in_review | design micro-badge + docs; legal to review wording | 2027-06-25 | potential UX clutter; product wants MVP badge only

Notes / How to use this sheet:
- This is a throwaway lightweight tracker for quick cross-team alignment. Keep rows to items that need owner + short decision within 2 weeks.
- Use status values: proposed | need_input | in_progress | blocked | done | closed
- "provisional_owner" is the person accountable for next step (may change).
- Keep follow_up_action to one-line next step; ping owner on Slack #ops-rapid if dates slip.

Short summary for exec sync (one-liner):
6 active items needing cross-team inputs (perf/finance/legal). Priority ask: telemetry tag alignment (blocked by finance) and prompt-set regression check for model swap (needs DE prompt samples).

Open questions / decisions requiring PO input:
- PO tradeoff on fallback: accept slight hallucination/regression to get 7% cost saving? (Marco)
- Finance: acceptable threshold for embedding drift before stopping quant pilot? (Sofia / Ravi)

Quick action list (next 72h):
- Marco: share perf tail CSV + short README to linked GH PR (done)
- Sofia: escalate embedding A/B results and tag 5 customer-samples for eval (in progress)
- Asha: gather 30 prompt samples and provide scrub checklist for privacy (owner)
- Elias: schedule 30-min sync with finance on telemetry schema (blocked)

Notes to self / scratch:
- If any row becomes stale >14 days, mark as "stale" in status and archive row in monthly cleanup sheet.
- This sheet intentionally light on structure — copy to dedicated trackers for anything >2 weeks.

Last edit log:
- 2027-06-11 Asha created initial rows from weekly ops huddle
- 2027-06-12 Marco added routing fallback perf numbers
- 2027-06-14 Priya updated SRE rollback status
- 2027-06-18 Asha refreshed summary and next steps before exec sync
